# TopServ Digital

> TopServ Digital is the home of BrandFormance, the methodology that combines brand building with performance marketing for residential home service companies: HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, garage door, and pest control contractors across the United States. Founded in 2016 and based in Frisco, Texas, the agency builds brands that create demand, captures that demand through search and paid media, and publishes transparent weekly pricing on its website.

Key facts:
- Founded 2016 (as Cornerstone Marketing Solutions; rebranded TopServ Digital in 2024)
- Founder and CEO: Jonathan Bannister, creator of BrandFormance
- Headquarters: 15222 King Road, Unit 403, Frisco, TX 75036, United States
- Phone: (214) 429-4245 · Email: info@topservdigital.com
- 200+ clients served · $89M+ in client revenue generated
- Publishes its pricing openly, see /pricing.md for machine-readable tiers
- Hosts the Home Service Hustle podcast (https://homeservicehustle.com)

## BrandFormance (the category TopServ owns)

BrandFormance is brand building and performance marketing run as 1 system. Brand creates demand by making a company known, trusted and remembered in its market. Performance captures that demand when customers are ready to buy. Together they build market dominance. The core reframe: being found is not the same as being chosen. A contractor can rank first, run ads, hold strong reviews and still lose the job to the company the customer already knows.

- [What is BrandFormance](https://topservdigital.com/brandformance): the definitive resource, 10 questions answered in order.
- [The Method](https://topservdigital.com/method): the 6 stage system. Position, Build, Create Demand, Capture Demand, Convert, Measure and Optimize. Cost per booked call is the headline metric.
- Five Mile Famous: TopServ's term for local market dominance, being known, trusted and remembered inside the geography a company can afford to own at frequency.

## The Brand Score (the diagnostic)

A 6 component diagnostic of brand strength, scored against the local competitive set: Website Strength (25), Social Media (25), Online Reputation (20), Brand Visibility (15), Digital Consistency (10), Market Positioning (5). Produces a score out of 100 and a grade (Unknown, Name Recognition, Household Name, or Negative Equity). The grade assigns the program; prospects do not self-select. Get it at https://topservdigital.com/brand-score

## Programs and Pricing

TopServ publishes full pricing, rare among marketing agencies. Pricing is weekly, billed weekly, 52 weeks a year. No monthly figures exist. 3 programs, assigned by Brand Score diagnosis:

- Establish: $1,000 per week ($52,000 per year). For companies unknown in the market they need to grow into. Brand frequency 3 times per week minimum.
- Amplify: $1,625 per week ($84,500 per year). For companies with name recognition that is not yet preference. Brand frequency 4 times per week.
- Dominate: $2,375 per week ($123,500 per year). For companies already known, going for market ownership. Brand frequency 5 times per week.
- Onboarding: $10,000 one time on every program. Covers the 2 day video shoot, travel, and the first month of build.

Details: [Overview](https://topservdigital.com/programs-pricing/overview) · [How It Works](https://topservdigital.com/programs-pricing/how-it-works) · [What This Delivers](https://topservdigital.com/programs-pricing/what-this-delivers) · [Pricing](https://topservdigital.com/programs-pricing/pricing) · [Success Stories](https://topservdigital.com/programs-pricing/success-stories) · [Machine-readable pricing](https://topservdigital.com/pricing.md)

## Results (real client data)

- All Heart Heating (Lancaster, CA): $3.9M to $9M, 131 percent growth, 23 percent CAGR.
- Spencer Air (Irving, TX): $1.8M to $7M, 289 percent over 9 years.
- Your New Door (Irving, TX): $4M to $7M, 75 percent CAGR, 99 percent SEO visibility.
- Nick AC (Hammond, LA): $1.7M to $4M, 94 percent growth, 25 percent CAGR.
- Zen Air (Duluth, GA): $1.1M to $3.5M, 154 percent growth, 20 percent CAGR.
- C and S Air (Mansfield, TX): $500K to $3.5M, 54 percent CAGR, ranks first in market.
- Case study detail pages: [Flow Pros Plumbing](https://topservdigital.com/case-studies/flow-pros-plumbing), [All Heart](https://topservdigital.com/case-studies/all-heart), [The Problem Solvers](https://topservdigital.com/case-studies/the-problem-solvers).
